name: ChatterMate Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source AI customer support chatbot with shared inbox, human handoff, web chat widget, knowledge-base answers and bring-your-own LLM; self-hosted core has no provider-imposed usage quota.
watch_out: Requires your own server, database and model/API provider; LLM tokens and messaging-channel services can cost money. Enterprise features and support are separately licensed. Production security and external integrations require configuration; no free cloud infrastructure is included.
